test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ustad Vilayat Khan, one of the great musicians from India, is globally renowned for playing which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sitar__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ustad Vilayat Khan was a prominent Sitar player.
 
• He was born on **28 August 1928** in **Gouripur** in East Bengal, now Bangladesh.
 
• He invented a new technique of playing Sitar with the left hand which lasts for longer consistency.
 
• He also invented many Ragas enriching Indian Music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
